defects.title: Non-positive quantities are accepted
defects.requirement: Every quantity must be a positive integer.
defects.evidence: The candidate removes the quantity validation before calculating subtotal.

defects.title: Tax is calculated before the coupon
defects.requirement: Apply the coupon to merchandise before calculating tax.
defects.evidence: The candidate changes the tax base from discounted to subtotal.

defects.title: The free-shipping equality boundary is excluded
defects.requirement: Free shipping starts when the discounted total is greater than or equal to the threshold.
defects.evidence: The candidate changes the comparison from >= to >.
